# CompuCell3D test fixtures

Two demo projects copied unchanged from CompuCell3D 4.10.0 (`CompuCell3D/core/Demos`), under the MIT licence
in `LICENSE-CompuCell3D.txt`:

- `cellsorting/`: `BookChapterDemos_ComputationalMethodsInCellBiology/cellsorting`, two cell types sorting by
  contact energies.
- `diffusion/`: `CompuCellPythonTutorial/diffusion`, a chemical field diffusing from an initial pulse.
